title: 第21章 警局震惊
content_zh:
美国。

    谷川跟着沃伦来到他找到的那个废弃电影院。

    推开那扇玻璃门，门轴发出一声干涩的呻吟。

    这是一家位于美国小镇边缘的旧式电影院，因为缺少观众，在半年前关闭了，现在被谷川给租了两天。

    这里已经被打扫过了，但还有淡淡的灰尘味。

    大厅里的灯是新安的，但还是很昏暗，因为谷川为了省钱买的是二手的。

    一群人还在里面忙碌。

    谷川对沃伦问道：“还能放电影吗？”

    “不能，但是能放图片。”沃伦说道。

    “那就够了。”

    谷川也不挑剔。

    他的目的反正只是应付一下小王，顺便刺激一下国内的票房，有几张照片就可以了。

    “这椅子怎么破成这样了？”

    “半年没人打理过了。”

    “喂，你，过来。”谷川指着一个胖子，把他喊过来说道：“你坐在这。”

    他的体型能把椅子挡住。

    “你们坐的分散一点，不要坐在一起。”

    安排了这个胖子之后，谷川又冲着大家喊了起来：“不要笑，不然扣钱，都给我看得认真点。”

    谷川到处转悠，补充着各种细节，尽量让这里显得更真实一点。

    “你是怎么打扫的？这里还有蜘蛛网没有看到吗？”

    “掉的爆米花不要扫，这样看上去更真实。”

    巡视了最后一圈之后，谷川终于满意地点头。

    “啪啪！”谷川拍手把大家的注意力都吸引到他这里，说道：“好了，大家准备好，要开始了。”

    谷川拿出沃伦的相机，找好拍摄位置之后，大声喊道：“沃伦，放图片！”

    “OK。”

    大荧幕上开始出现照片，谷川拿着相机，一连拍摄了很多。

    拍摄的素材足够之后，谷川说道：“好了，沃伦放最后一张图片，大家站起来鼓掌。”

    众人按照谷川的要求去做。

    很快，电影放映结束，观众起立鼓掌的照片就被拍摄下来。

    “漂亮。”

    看着这些照片，谷川脸上的笑容难以收敛。

    万无一失。
content_en:
USA.

    Tanigawa followed Warren to the abandoned movie theater he found.

    Pushing open the glass door, the door shaft let out a dry groan.

    This is an old-style movie theater located on the edge of a small American town. It closed half a year ago due to lack of audiences, and is now rented by Tanigawa for two days.

    The place had been cleaned, but there was still a faint smell of dust.

    The lights in the hall were newly installed, but they were still very dim because Tanichuan bought them second-hand to save money.

    A group of people are still busy inside.

    Tanigawa asked Warren, "Can we still show movies?"

    "No, but you can put pictures," Warren said.

    "That's enough."

    Tanikawa isn’t picky either.

    Anyway, his purpose is just to deal with Xiao Wang and stimulate the domestic box office by the way. A few photos will be enough.

    "Why is this chair so broken?"

    "No one has taken care of it for half a year."

    "Hey, come here." Tanichuan pointed at a fat man, called him over and said, "Sit here."

    He's big enough to block a chair.

    "Sit more spread out, don't sit together."

    After arranging for the fat man, Tanichuan shouted to everyone again: "Don't laugh, otherwise you will be deducted money. Please look at me seriously."

    Tanichuan walked around, adding various details, trying to make the place look more real.

    "How did you clean it? Are there any spider webs here?"

    "Don't sweep up the dropped popcorn, it will look more realistic."

    After the last round of inspection, Tanichuan finally nodded with satisfaction.

    "Bah!" Tanichuan clapped his hands to draw everyone's attention to him and said, "Okay, everyone, get ready, let's start."

    Tanigawa took out Warren's camera, found the shooting position, and shouted: "Warren, show the picture!"

    "OK."

    Photos began to appear on the big screen. Tanichuan took a camera and took many photos in succession.

    After enough material was taken, Tanigawa said: "Okay, Warren will show the last picture, and everyone will stand up and applaud."

    Everyone did as Tanichuan asked.

    Soon after the film screening ended, photos of the audience standing and applauding were taken.

    "Beautiful."

    Looking at these photos, Tanichuan couldn't hold back the smile on his face.

    Foolproof.
